relationships.subject: PANX1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of PANX1 channels promotes extracellular ATP accumulation, which subsequently activates P2RX7 receptors and initiates downstream inflammatory cascades.

relationships.subject: CASP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Caspase-1 is a central effector molecule responsible for the maturation of IL-1β and IL-18

key_findings: Fibromyalgia patients had higher serum CASP1, GSDME, PANX1, P2RX7 and TOS, and lower GSDMD, NLRP3, IL-18 and TAS
CASP1 and TAS gave the highest AUC (0.898); profile does not support coordinated canonical inflammasome activation
